raw_html: [[Embrace of the Spider Queen (enchantment)|Embrace of the Spider Queen]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Embrace of the Spider Queen (enchantment)|Embrace of the Spider Queen]]:''' While Lolth protects her faithful from the venom of her spiders, non-evil beings who bear items sacred to her may feel her displeasure, suffering a -6 penalty to Fortitude saving throws versus Poison.
